elements.name: Darkvision
elements.desc: See in dim light within 60 feet as if bright, and in darkness as if dim.

elements.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
elements.desc: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

elements.name: Powerful Build
elements.desc: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

elements.name: Long-Limbed
elements.desc: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

elements.name: Sneaky
elements.desc: You are proficient in the Stealth skill.

elements.name: Surprise Attack
elements.desc: If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

elements.name: Bugbear
elements.desc: In some campaigns, humanoids normally regarded as sinister threats can emerge to adventure alongside humans and the other standard races. +2 Strength, +1 Dexterity, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Fury of the Small
elements.desc: When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

elements.name: Nimble Escape
elements.desc: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

elements.name: Goblin
elements.desc: In some campaigns, humanoids normally regarded as sinister threats can emerge to adventure alongside humans and the other standard races. +2 Dexterity, +1 Constitution, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Martial Training
elements.desc: You are proficient with two martial weapons of your choice and with light armor. Workaround: light armor proficiency is granted automatically; choose your two martial weapons manually on the sheet.

elements.name: Saving Face
elements.desc: Hobgoblins are careful not to show weakness in front of their allies, for fear of losing status. If you miss with an attack roll or fail an ability check or a saving throw, you can gain a bonus to the roll equal to the number of allies you can see within 30 feet of you (maximum bonus of +5). Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

elements.name: Hobgoblin
elements.desc: In some campaigns, humanoids normally regarded as sinister threats can emerge to adventure alongside humans and the other standard races. +2 Constitution, +1 Intelligence, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
elements.desc: As an action on your turn, you can cower pathetically to distract nearby foes. Until the end of your next turn, your allies gain advantage on attack rolls against enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

elements.name: Pack Tactics
elements.desc: You have advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

elements.name: Kobold
elements.desc: In some campaigns, humanoids normally regarded as sinister threats can emerge to adventure alongside humans and the other standard races. +2 Dexterity, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Aggressive
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you can move up to your speed toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

elements.name: Primal Intuition
elements.desc: You have proficiency in two of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, and Survival.

elements.name: Orc
elements.desc:
In some campaigns, humanoids normally regarded as sinister threats can emerge to adventure alongside humans and the other standard races. +2 Strength, +1 Constitution, speed 30 ft.

Note: Uses errata — Primal Intuition replaces the original Menacing trait.

elements.name: Innate Spellcasting (Yuan-Ti)
elements.desc: You know the poison spray cantrip. You can cast animal friendship an unlimited number of times with this trait, but you can target only snakes with it. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast suggestion with this trait. Once you cast it, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

elements.name: Magic Resistance
elements.desc: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

elements.name: Poison Immunity
elements.desc: You are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition.

elements.name: Yuan-Ti Pureblood
elements.desc: In some campaigns, humanoids normally regarded as sinister threats can emerge to adventure alongside humans and the other standard races. +2 Charisma, +1 Intelligence, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Celestial Resistance
elements.desc: You have resistance to necrotic damage and radiant damage.

elements.name: Healing Hands
elements.desc: As an action, you can touch a creature and cause it to regain a number of hit points equal to your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Light Bearer
elements.desc: You know the light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

elements.name: Aasimar
elements.desc: Aasimar bear within their souls the light of the heavens. They are descended from humans with a touch of the power of Mount Celestia, the divine realm of many lawful good deities. +2 Charisma, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Protector Aasimar
elements.desc: Protector aasimar are charged by the powers of good to guard the weak, to strike at evil wherever it arises, and to stand vigilant against the darkness. +1 Wisdom, plus Radiant Soul.

elements.name: Radiant Soul
elements.desc:
Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to unleash the divine energy within yourself, causing your eyes to glimmer and two luminous, incorporeal wings to sprout from your back.

Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. During it, you have a flying speed of 30 feet, and once on each of your turns, you can deal extra radiant damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra radiant damage equals your level.

Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Scourge Aasimar
elements.desc: Scourge aasimar are imbued with a divine energy that blazes intensely within them. It feeds a powerful desire to destroy evil. +1 Constitution, plus Radiant Consumption.

elements.name: Radiant Consumption
elements.desc:
Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to unleash the divine energy within yourself, causing a searing light to radiate from you, pour out of your eyes and mouth, and threaten to char you.

Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. During it, you shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet, and at the end of each of your turns, you and each creature within 10 feet of you take radiant damage equal to half your level (rounded up). In addition, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra radiant damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra radiant damage equals your level.

Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Fallen Aasimar
elements.desc: An aasimar who was touched by dark powers as a youth or who turns to evil in early adulthood can become one of the fallen — a group of aasimar whose inner light has been replaced by shadow. +1 Strength, plus Necrotic Shroud.

elements.name: Necrotic Shroud
elements.desc:
Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to unleash the divine energy within yourself, causing your eyes to turn into pools of darkness and two skeletal, ghostly, flightless wings to sprout from your back. The instant you transform, other creatures within 10 feet of you that can see you must each succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or become frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. During it, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra necrotic damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra necrotic damage equals your level.

Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Firbolg Magic
elements.desc: You can cast detect magic and disguise self with this trait, using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability for them. Once you cast either spell, you can't cast it again with this trait until you finish a short or long rest. When you use this version of disguise self, you can seem up to 3 feet shorter than normal, allowing you to more easily blend in with humans and elves.

elements.name: Hidden Step
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you can magically turn invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, make a damage roll, or force someone to make a saving throw. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

elements.id: Racial Trait:Speech of Beast and Leaf
elements.name: Speech of Beast and Leaf
elements.desc: You have the ability to communicate in a limited manner with beasts and plants. They can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in return. You have advantage on all Charisma checks you make to influence them.

elements.name: Firbolg
elements.desc: Firbolg tribes cloister in remote forest strongholds, preferring to spend their days in quiet harmony with the woods. +2 Wisdom, +1 Strength, speed 30 ft.

rules.grant: Racial Trait:Speech of Beast and Leaf

elements.name: Natural Athlete
elements.desc: You have proficiency in the Athletics skill.

elements.name: Stone's Endurance
elements.desc: You can focus yourself to occasionally shrug off injury. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled, and reduce the damage by that total. After you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

elements.name: Mountain Born
elements.desc: You have resistance to cold damage. You're also acclimated to high altitude, including elevations above 20,000 feet.

elements.name: Goliath
elements.desc: At the highest mountain peaks dwell the reclusive goliaths. Their bodies look as if they are carved from mountain stone and give them great physical power. +2 Strength, +1 Constitution, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Expert Forgery
elements.desc: You can duplicate other creatures' handwriting and craftwork. You have advantage on all checks made to produce forgeries or duplicates of existing objects.

elements.name: Kenku Training
elements.desc: You are proficient in your choice of two of the following skills: Acrobatics, Deception, Stealth, and Sleight of Hand.

elements.name: Mimicry
elements.desc: You can mimic sounds you have heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds you make can tell they are imitations with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check opposed by your Charisma (Deception) check.

elements.name: Kenku
elements.desc: Haunted by an ancient crime that robbed them of their wings, the kenku wander the world as vagabonds and burglars who live at the edge of human society. +2 Dexterity, +1 Wisdom, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Bite
elements.desc: Your fanged maw is a natural weapon, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with it, you deal piercing damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

elements.name: Cunning Artisan
elements.desc: As part of a short rest, you can harvest bone and hide from a slain beast, construct, dragon, monstrosity, or plant creature of size Small or larger to create one of the following items: a shield, a club, a javelin, or 1d4 darts or blowgun needles. To use this trait, you need a blade, such as a dagger, or appropriate artisan's tools, such as leatherworker's tools.

elements.name: Hold Breath
elements.desc: You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes at a time.

elements.name: Hunter's Lore
elements.desc: You gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Nature, Perception, Stealth, and Survival.

elements.name: Natural Armor (Lizardfolk)
elements.desc: You have tough, scaly skin. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

elements.name: Hungry Jaws
elements.desc: In battle, you can throw yourself into a vicious feeding frenzy. As a bonus action, you can make a special attack with your bite. If the attack hits, it deals its normal damage, and you gain temporary hit points (minimum of 1) equal to your Constitution modifier, and you can't use this trait again until you finish a short or long rest.

elements.name: Lizardfolk
elements.desc: Only a fool looks at the lizardfolk and sees nothing more than scaly humanoids. Lizardfolk possess an alien and inscrutable mindset, their desires and thoughts driven by a different set of basic principles. +2 Constitution, +1 Wisdom, speed 30 ft., swim 30 ft.

elements.name: Feline Agility
elements.desc: Your reflexes and agility allow you to move with a burst of speed. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your speed until the end of the turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

elements.name: Cat's Claws
elements.desc: Because of your claws, you have a climbing speed of 20 feet. In addition, your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

elements.name: Cat's Talent
elements.desc: You have proficiency in the Perception and Stealth skills.

elements.name: Tabaxi
elements.desc: Hailing from a strange and distant land, wandering tabaxi are catlike humanoids driven by curiosity to collect interesting artifacts, gather tales and stories, and lay eyes on all the world's wonders. +2 Dexterity, +1 Charisma, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Amphibious
elements.desc: You can breathe air and water.

elements.name: Control Air and Water
elements.desc: A child of the sea, you can call on the magic of elemental air and water. You can cast fog cloud with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast gust of wind with it, and starting at 5th level, you can also cast wall of water with it. Once you cast a spell with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

elements.name: Emissary of the Sea
elements.desc: Aquatic beasts have an extraordinary affinity with your people. You can communicate simple ideas with beasts that can breathe water. They can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in return.

elements.name: Guardians of the Depths
elements.desc: Adapted to even the most extreme ocean depths, you have resistance to cold damage, and you ignore any of the drawbacks caused by a deep, underwater environment.

elements.name: Triton
elements.desc: Tritons guard the ocean depths, building small settlements beside deep trenches, portals to the elemental planes, and other dangerous spots far from the eyes of land-bound folk. +1 Strength, +1 Constitution, +1 Charisma, speed 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
